alias_policy: Primal rw, incoming output cotangent b_rw_out, accumulating input cotangent b_rw_in and failure slots are disjoint, as in COMMON-AD section 36.4. The tangent d_rw is transformed in place.
derivative: Accumulate the incoming interior cotangents into b_rw_in; leave its endpoint values unchanged. Consume and zero b_rw_out at both overwritten endpoints, leaving incoming interior slots unchanged.
affine_reason: This row overwrites the two endpoints with constant zero and copies every interior element unchanged, so the map is a fixed linear mask.

cotangent_lifetime.write: Only endpoint cotangents are consumed and set to exact +0; interior output cotangents remain bitwise unchanged.
cotangent_lifetime.alias: The incoming output cotangent and accumulating input cotangent are separate buffers.
